skipped_or_inconclusive: End-to-end submit happy path could not be fully exercised via the headless browser because the SignaturePad canvas didn't register the synthetic mouse stroke (button stayed disabled). This is a test-harness artifact, not a code bug — submit + 🟢/🟡/🔴 confirmation routing was already verified in iter251 + iter252. The v1.1 changes are purely additive in the checklist/HelpTip/EmployeeCombo layer and do NOT touch submit or confirmation logic.

OOS submit with Exhaust system FAIL was attempted via DOM walk; the FAIL button click resolved to the Service brakes row (selector scoping issue inside the test), so the on-screen Exhaust-specific rationale assertion was not exercised. Compensating evidence: backend /api/fleet/_meta verified to return the (v1.1 commercial-vehicle addition 2026-05-19 PM) marker in the Exhaust rationale, and the SeverityRationale component is known from iter252 to render this string verbatim.
action_items: (Cleanup) The /api/employees collection now contains a Phase2v11 Test Driver row (id 74c8257a-5754-46ec-8a9b-0daabc27550b) created by this test. /api/employees/{id} DELETE returned 404 (no delete endpoint exposed). Main agent should either (a) drop the row directly from db.employees or (b) add a DELETE endpoint if employee cleanup is expected.

(Nice-to-have) The submit-button test artifact suggests SignaturePad would be easier to drive in tests with a programmatic 'mark as signed' affordance (e.g. exposing setSignature via a data-testid placeholder).
critical_code_review_comments: v1.1 refinement is implemented entirely in additive/data-driven fashion — checklists_fleet.py (84 truck / 25 trailer items), fleet_defect_severity.py (109 items · 74 OOS · 35 Monitor · v1_1_refinements list), i18n.js (~8 new EN→ES pairs), NewFleetDVIR.jsx (3 walk-around HelpTips + 1 conditional coupling HelpTip + EmployeeCombo driver field). Clean separation; no logic risk to submit/confirmation pipeline.

EmployeeCombo correctly uses module-level _cache with empty-fallback guard and clearEmployeeCache() bust after /api/employees/add — same defensive pattern as SupplierCombo. Case-insensitive dedup is enforced server-side (per problem statement) and the combo's exactMatch comparison is also lowercased, so the 'Add to roster' button correctly hides when a case-insensitive duplicate is already in the list.
Coupling HelpTip is wrapped inside the `trailers.length > 0` branch as a fragment, so the conditional render is correct and clean.

Backend severity_by_item rationale strings now include the '(v1.1 commercial-vehicle addition 2026-05-19 PM)' marker on the 5 new items, giving Shop/Safety auditors a clear provenance trail in the on-form 'Why this matters' panel — operator-approved tag, recommended as the standard pattern for future severity-table revisions.
